title: FlapLab Daily — CHOKE BREWERS CHOKE
story: You are the Milwaukee Brewers. Down 4-0 in World Series Game 2, a Rays fan tweeted 'CHOKE BREWERS CHOKE'. Dodge the Rays and come back anyway — Game 3 is tonight in Tampa.
inspiration: World Series 2026 Game 2 (Oct 24): Brewers rallied from 4-0 down to beat the Rays 5-4 and lead 2-0; the viral 'COME OUTSIDE BREWERS FANS... CHOKE BREWERS CHOKE!!' Rays-fan post got ratioed into a didn't-age-well meme (X trending, Oct 25). Game 3 Mon Oct 26 in Tampa. Bird = Brewers ball-in-glove roundel, pillars = Rays wordmark, sky = American Family Field (Wikimedia Commons).
